rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a very poor early blastocyst with absent/sparse ICM and TE, but is inconsistent about stage (0 vs 1 vs 3, collapsed vs early blastocyst) and adds uncertain cavity estimates.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, thin endometrium, BMI, and smoking into prognosis reasonably well, though some links are speculative and repetitive.
Contains multiple contradictions and shifting estimates (0-3%, 1-5%, 2-8%) and inconsistent morphology interpretations, weakening the logic chain.

Mostly consistent with general IVF principles on poor morphology, smoking cessation, thin lining, and sperm evaluation, but includes some nonstandard grading discussion and speculative recommendations such as PGT-A/freeze-all without strong case-specific support.
Provides practical next steps including smoking cessation, uterine cavity assessment, sperm workup/ICSI consideration, and future cycle planning, though recommendations are somewhat diffuse.
